label: 南侧入口至东路资料模型 · 庭院表面细化
heightEvidence: Estimated to depict the observed raised granite walkway over exposed cobbled court. Published section confirms changes of level but its numbers cannot be reliably read at 1080 px; no claim of surveyed elevation.
materialEvidence: THAD courtyard photograph shows small rounded cobbles, muted grey/brown stone, soil and localized green growth. Texture is an original representative PBR material, not a scan or pixel registration of historic stones.
supportEvidence: Short supports and beams beneath the granite walkway are visible in the courtyard photo. Support spacing and cross-sections are construction approximations, not surveyed structural drawings.
limits: External stair and courtyard level differences remain approximate; the old 0.5 m site datum and camera path are preserved.
No inscribed objects, artefacts, or speculative historic building interiors are added.
Individual cobble shapes, moss patches and support spacing are representational.
THAD and the photographer retain copyright in the references; local research study only.
markedFootprint: Plan label 9 is retained as a neutral footprint, without invented inscriptions or a stele object. Its exact finish remains unverified.
drawingsVerification: THAD official JPEG and ARCHINA credited project drawing are byte-identical at 1080x764. WeChat required verification; no higher-resolution section acquired. Numeric level labels were not treated as confirmed values.
rights: Source drawings THAD and architectural photography Wu Ji Photography retain copyright. Local study only; public redistribution permission not obtained. Original representative PBR textures and model modifications authored in this task.

build.scope: Connected source-plan route with an exposed courtyard footprint, representative cobble material and inferred modern walkway supports; individual relics and precise levels remain incomplete.

reproduce: TEMP/TMP and all Blender config/scripts/datafiles under [开发环境路径已省略]/龙虎山项目
Copy GLB and sources companion into website public/assets/models; public/assets/interiors/shangqing-entry-route.json selects the derived court model.
exportNotes: The active Broad surface variation layer is explicitly exported as glTF COLOR_0; all-vertex-colors export is disabled to avoid a neutral COLOR_0 preceding the real tint.
